name: thea2
description: Thea2 — exemplar-first rebuild of Thea. Spec corpus complete; code lands stage-by-stage per ROADMAP.md.

scripts.test: npm run test:a && npm run test:b
scripts.test:c1: npm run test:c1a && npm run test:c1b
scripts.test:c2: vitest run test/bridge test/consolidate test/coupling test/corpus test/derive test/embed test/events test/inhibit test/kernel
scripts.test:a: npm run test:c1 && npm run test:c2
scripts.test:b: vitest run test/life test/loop test/memory test/model test/probes test/realize test/sched test/siblings src
scripts.gates: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run depcruise && npm run verify && npm run docs:check

//: Scripts are honest: they fail loudly rather than silently passing. `gates` chains the four static gates (typecheck, lint, depcruise, verify); `corpus:check` is the hermetic derived-corpus gate. The CLI verbs run through the bin wrappers (deploy/bin/thea2, deploy/bin/thead) or tsx directly — `derive` deliberately has no npm script because it spends real model calls and is human-invoked only (ADR-007).
